the owner confirmed the original labelling: 'нет' is a separate manager utterance

owner's allowance: the lost turn is a backchannel 'да'; it carries no value for LLM extraction or for dialogue metrics, and the limit has been measured (five embedding windows, best margin +0.043, below the false-positive margin +0.056 in the negative zone; there is no manager segment at all inside the diarization gap 9.03-9.41). Revisit once stereo from the PBX becomes available

note: The reference was built from the owner's manual labelling (start of the call), signal analysis (energy VAD + fundamental frequency) and the service transcript. Sex by pitch: female ~165-240 Hz, male ~86-146 Hz. WARNING: autocorrelation pitch at 8 kHz gives an octave error - a male voice at 97-105 Hz reads as 195-205 Hz and looks female. That very error made the first revision of the reference assign zone 9.3-12.2 to the manager in full; check sex by the lowest strong autocorrelation peak, not by the highest.

text_status_legend.owner_confirmed: text confirmed by the owner by ear

text_status_legend.corrected_by_pitch: service text, but the speaker or the boundary was corrected by fundamental frequency
text_status_legend.unknown: speech is physically there, the text is not; filled in by the owner after the best run

masking: a token in angle brackets (<ИМЯ>) is an anonymisation mask: in WER it matches any word of the run
